# kilhog_subnet (Data Source)

Reads an existing Kilhog subnet by network ID and subnet ID or name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "kilhog_network" "production" {
  name = "production"
}

data "kilhog_subnet" "dmz" {
  network_id = data.kilhog_network.production.id
  name       = "dmz"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `network_id` (String) UUID of the network that owns the subnet.

### Optional

- `id` (String) Subnet UUID. Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be set.
- `name` (String) Subnet name within the network. Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `address` (String) Network address for the subnet.
- `description` (String) Subnet description.
- `parent_id` (String) UUID of the parent resource reported by the API.
- `parent_kind` (String) Parent kind reported by the API (`network` or `subnet`).
- `parent_subnet_id` (String) UUID of the parent subnet when the subnet is nested.
- `prefix` (Number) IPv4 prefix length.
- `tags` (Attributes List) Key-value metadata tags. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `type` (String) Address family.

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String) Tag key.
- `value` (String) Tag value.
